prompt: Grignard + epoxide: ethylene oxide + propylmagnesium bromide; then H3O+. Draw the alcohol (chain-extended by 2 C).
explanation: Grignard attacks the less-hindered C of the epoxide (SN2-like), ring opens to the alkoxide. H3O+ protonates. Net result: 2-carbon chain extension to a 1° alcohol. Great synthetic trick when you want OH two carbons away.
